description: pdf.js viewer with page navigation + zoom, using the signed render_url contract (GET /documents/:id/render?page=N) and proven usable on scanned/rotated packs.

userStories.title: Open and view a PDF
userStories.description: Open a document viewer route from a Matter and render the PDF via pdf.js using the render_url contract.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-001 From a Matter, I can open a document viewer route for a selected document.
AC-002 Viewer fetches render_url via GET /documents/:id/render?page=N (1-indexed page) and renders via pdf.js.
AC-003 Viewer shows an explicit error state if render_url is unavailable or the document is not found.
userStories.notes: NO-GO until RH1 spike evidence is recorded.

userStories.title: Page navigation and zoom stays responsive on scans
userStories.description: Page jump and zoom remain usable on pack_07 scanned/rotated PDFs.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-004 PDFs served to pdf.js support Range requests (Accept-Ranges: bytes; Range returns 206 Partial Content).
AC-005 Define totalMs as request page N -> renderTask.promise resolve (exclude initial PDF load). Serial N=20 @100%: p95(totalMs) < 1000ms and max(totalMs) < 1500ms.
AC-006 Spam N=30 @200ms: maxLongTaskMs < 250ms and final page completes < 1500ms after request; >=70% intermediate renders cancelled.
AC-007 Zoom 50/100/150 re-renders consistently (no CSS-scaling drift).
